title: cerastium bungeanum
intro: Cerastium bungeanum, commonly known as Snow-in-summer or Mountain Snow, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress, improve sleep quality, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium bungeanum include anti-bacterial and anti-viral effects, as well as its ability to promote wound healing and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
